title: Committee Hearings & Witness-Slip Feed
description: Aggregate document produced by actions/scrape-hearings and consumed by docs/src/dashboard/index.html. One document holds the upcoming committee hearings for every supported jurisdiction, the bills each hearing covers, and (best-effort) witness-slip counts. Unlike the bill dataset this is not point-in-time bill metadata — it is a rolling window of near-future committee activity, refreshed by the Pages deploy (twice daily).

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this document was built (data-lineage marker for the dashboard 'as of' badge).

source.description: Human-readable provenance shown in the dashboard footer.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions whose hearings this document covers, with the citizen-participation portal for filing.

participation.description: How the public weighs in on a hearing in this jurisdiction.

portal_url.description: Official portal where a resident files a slip / signs in / comments.

counts.description: Hearing count per jurisdiction code (convenience for the dashboard).

id.description: Stable identifier: <jurisdiction>-<chamber>-<committeeId>-<hearingId> (IL) or wa-<chamber>-<agendaId> (WA). Idempotent across runs.

title.description: Subject matter / agenda line as published.

scheduled_iso.description: Local wall-clock start time as naive ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), no offset applied. Pair with `timezone` for display. Null when the source time was unparseable. Sort within a jurisdiction lexicographically.

scheduled_display.description: Source-formatted start time string for direct display.

timezone.description: IANA tz name the local time is in (e.g. America/Chicago).

status.description: Canceled hearings are kept (they close a slip window) but flagged.

bills.description: Bills on the agenda for this hearing.

id.description: Compact bill id, e.g. HB1643, SB25.

slips.description: Best-effort aggregate witness-slip counts. Null/absent is the common case — many capitols only expose counts while a slip window is open, so consumers must treat this as optional.

witness_slip_url.description: Deep link to the official portal to file a slip / sign in for this hearing or bill.

source.description: Origin host, e.g. ilga.gov or leg.wa.gov.
